title: Gitcoin Grants Round Data
description: Historical data from Gitcoin quadratic funding rounds including grant applications, voting patterns, and funding outcomes.
challenges: Identify optimal quadratic funding parameters for different community sizes
Detect and prevent collusion in voting patterns
Design fair allocation mechanisms with limited budgets
Measure long-term impact of funded projects

title: Broadlistening Dataset
description: Comprehensive dataset of Ethereum public goods projects and their impact metrics, providing insights into decentralized funding mechanisms and community governance patterns.
challenges: Analyze effectiveness of different public goods funding mechanisms
Measure community engagement and governance participation patterns
Identify factors that contribute to successful public goods projects
Design optimal incentive structures for sustainable public goods funding
